coverageNote: Publicly disclosed Malabar fund holdings, not Sumeet Nagar’s personal portfolio. 22 company records: 18 June snapshots, Affle and Le Travenues September 30 originals, Neogen September 16 provider snapshot and one unresolved Virtuoso August capital-change record. Individual dates control freshness; June data is not relabelled September. Ownership percentages are of each company, not portfolio weights. Named disclosure thresholds and incomplete filing collection leave holdings unobserved; absence is not a sale. Malabar Select Fund is not combined with Malabar India Fund. Tanfac’s newer below-1% signal is noted against its historical June row. Two September rows have original filings checked; 19 rows are provider cross-checks and one remains unresolved.
